newsitem.title: FRANCE: Axa has 600-700 mln Ffr gain from deal.
newsitem.headline: Axa has 600-700 mln Ffr gain from deal.

text.p: French insurer Axa said on Thursday that it expected a 600-700 million franc capital gain from the sale by its U.S. unit Equitable Cos Inc of its real estate division.

It said Equitable would record a $180-$200 million capital gain on the $400 million sale announced on Wednesday of Equitable Real Estate Investment Management to Sydney-based property and insurance group Lend Lease Corp.
Equitable is owned 60.4 percent by Axa.
"The gain (for Equitable) net of taxes and transaction costs is $180-200 million," said an Axa spokeswoman, adding that the transaction costs still had not been finalised.
"Given that Axa controls 60.4 percent of Equitable, on the basis of 5.75 francs to $1, the net gain for Axa is 600-700 million francs," she said.
